rules_evaluated.evidence: Current L46 (Delivery mode) states: 'In-room M5 opener, single wiring... do not re-file it as prework' — matching learn-from-the-test.md:185 ('lectures/reading-the-return.md is an M5 in-room opener, not a pre-read. Do not re-file it as prework without also charging M5's clock...'). Three lines later, current L49 (Watch-fors) still reads: 'The pre-read names failure modes, not fixes.' Re-verified live this session: run-the-first-experiment.md's actual '## Pre-reads before Module 5' block (lines 71-105) runs five entries (Mollick's Bitter Lesson vs Garbage Can, steering, Klaassen sandwich, verification-asymmetry, compound engineering) — none names goal drift, context rot, or plausible-but-wrong. So L49's claim is false under the controlled vocabulary.md definition of 'pre-read' (a genuinely different surface), and self-contradicts L46 three lines above if read as a loose self-reference instead — either reading is a leftover from before the 2026-08-17 wiring correction, when this file itself was filed as the pre-read. Harm: Watch-fors is the section a trainer reads at delivery time; taken at face value it implies the failure-mode naming already happened elsewhere, when this lecture is the ONLY surface that names them — a trainer could under-deliver or rush the naming believing it is a recap. Unchanged since the last pedagogy pin (d5aa7e3d) — confirmed via git diff d5aa7e3d..HEAD, which touches neither L46 nor L49.
